question: The intention_fidelity sieve at 80%/20% keyword thresholds reds 0-of-174 live charter/ticket pairs green — do you want it built as written (every component red at its next crossing, this one first), the thresholds set from the measurement (e.g. red only below the corpus median, with the number's provenance declared as this census), or the measure itself reshaped (whole charter vs ticket falsifier, or a judgement the LLM makes and the sieve only records)?
why_it_blocks: the ticket's how fixes the sieve's numbers (coverage < 80% reds, invented > 20% reds) without a measurement behind them; measured 2026-09-18 over the live corpus, 0 of 174 charter/ticket pairs (50 charters) pass — median falsifier-to-falsifier coverage 19%, best 73% (openai_wire); median invented 90%; 18 charters carry no falsifier key at all and read 0%. Built as written, the sieve reds every component at its next PROVEME crossing, build_inspector included at this very ticket's own crossing — a deterministic red I may not plaster and cannot fix without choosing a number the ticket already chose. The whole charter (every field, not the falsifier alone) covers the ticket falsifier at median 59%, 6 pairs at 80%+, 125 at 50%+.
